title: DeepSeek Harness known Remote error codes
description: Known codes for this package build. An unknown code remains opaque diagnostic data; preserve its original code, message and details without inferring recovery or permissions. This schema recognizes codes only and does not validate error envelopes or details.

oneOf.description: The requested preset conflicts with the existing Session's preset.
The id is unusable, already taken, or its composition cannot be installed.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly agentPreset: string; readonly reason: string }

oneOf.description: The session's conversation has started, so its composition is fixed.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly sessionId: SessionId; readonly agentPreset: string }

oneOf.description: No declaration supplies the requested identity.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly agentPreset: string; readonly available: readonly string[] }

oneOf.description: Provider or input failure, without original text or response details.
The provider refused a valid credential write, for example because the stored document no longer parses. The details name only the reference, never the value.
The bounded replay ledger cannot admit another nonce until existing receipts expire.
The signed admission timestamp fell outside the acceptance window.
The addressed device grant was already revoked.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly deviceId: string; readonly revokedAt: number }

oneOf.description: The presented public key is not a base64 Ed25519 SPKI DER.
The addressed device grant does not exist.
The presented code expired before redemption.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly code: string; readonly expiresAt: number }

oneOf.description: The presented code is unknown or was already redeemed.
The timestamp is below the durable replay floor, or the nonce was already consumed.
The parent is not fully qualified, the name is not one segment, or creation failed.
A child of that name is already there.
The verb needs an interaction the composed backend does not serve.
The target is not fully qualified, or the backend cannot list it.
The source was authorized, but its conversion failed.
The code host refused the change or could not be reached; the message gives the host's reason.
The code host did not provide the change request's diff or file, or its status has not been read yet; the message says why.
The patch, the untracked file list, or the file exceeds `maxDiffBytes`, or the code host or its provider refuses a change request's diff or file over a size limit.
The requested base branch name is empty.
No remote names a default branch that HEAD shares history with, and the checkout is not a worktree the Session created.
The Session has no created worktree to restore or leave.
The Session's directory is not inside a Git checkout, so it has no local changes.
The URL is not a visible binding of the Session that a provider serves, so the panel does not act on it.
No message of the Session waits after a failed or stopped attempt to create its worktree.
The removed worktree could not be checked out again; the message gives the reason.
The Session's Agent is not loaded or has other work, so its checkout cannot change now.
A turn of the Session has started, or its worktree was created, so its worktree request can no longer change.
The change request has new commits since the head the user confirmed, so it was not merged.
No registered provider serves the change request URL.
No worktree service is mounted.
More than one live provider claims the requested endpoint.
Named arguments do not match the endpoint's declared parameters.
The HTTP carrier returned 401; authenticate with the Host before explicitly retrying the operation.
Owner-side business validation refused the request; `issues` carries portable diagnostics when a codec produced them.
The service's Remote binding is malformed or disagrees with its registration.
The call was cancelled by the carrier signal or the backend.
The Client connection is not ready to admit this operation; reconnect does not automatically resubmit it.
The Host Context adapter failed while resolving the requested receiver.
The Host Context adapter found no receiver for the supplied identity.
The Host Context adapter required by this endpoint is not registered.
No live generated definition or source declaration exposes this endpoint.
The HTTP carrier returned 503 for this request; it does not invalidate an otherwise ready generation.
A wire argument or uplink item fails the endpoint's input codec.
The Peer cannot participate in interactions or the reply belongs to another Peer.
Carrier, dispatch, or unclassified Host failure.
The requested forwarded invocation cannot be answered through this caller.
A lookup provider failed while resolving a wire identity.
A lookup provider found no object for the supplied identity.
The lookup provider required by a parameter is not registered.
The declared method has no callable implementation on its live receiver.
The calling Peer was disposed before the operation could be admitted.
The HTTP carrier returned 403, or a device-identified request was refused; the refusal does not establish that a device was revoked.
The Host cannot complete the requested preparation operation.
A carrier frame violates the Remote protocol.
The supplied or negotiated API protocol is unsupported; update the application before reconnecting.
The live provider disagrees with the endpoint's declared service or namespace.
A method result fails its declared output codec or stream mode.
The endpoint's service or forwarded event source is unavailable.
A source method's signature cannot be dispatched as a Remote method.
Received stream data failed validation; event-generation failure suspends automatic reconnect until explicit recovery.
The request transport was interrupted, a logical stream exhausted carrier retries, or an otherwise unclassified HTTP failure occurred; mutation acceptance may be unknown.
oneOf.x-typescript-details:
| { readonly endpoint: string; readonly httpStatus?: number }
      | { readonly stream: string }

oneOf.description: Buffered Client uplink data exceeded the logical stream's byte limit.
The admitted Host lacks a capability required by discovery or the requested operation.
This delivery can no longer accept an answer; it does not identify which Client settled the interaction.
The Host deadline elapsed before the pending interaction was settled.
The session's job list no longer carries a killable row under that id.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly sessionId: SessionId; readonly jobId: JobId }

oneOf.description: The Relay's audit trail could not be read; `body` carries a relay answer unchanged.
A submitted capability names an endpoint the plugin does not offer under that kind.
The requested access mode is not one this build stores.
The requested fork switch is not a boolean.
The submitted capability selection is not a list of plugin groups.
The requested Relay address is not a usable base URL.
The posted Relay address is neither null nor a string, or does not normalize.
The requested tier is not one this build drives.
The requested lifetime is not a positive safe-integer count of minutes within the ceiling.
A permission update named neither the tier nor the fork switch.
A creation or publish check named no Session.
A share-writing request named no share.
Creating a share requires a verified owner credential at the effective Relay.
The owner state file could not be written; the previous record is still in force.
The Relay did not accept the registration this host attempted.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly relay: string; readonly reason?: string }

oneOf.description: The effective Relay predates owner identity binding, so a verified credential cannot help.
No Liveshare server address is saved, so the request has nowhere to publish or probe.
No share this host publishes carries the requested id.
A submitted capability names a plugin that offers no viewer endpoints.
A draft provider interrogation refused or failed.
The resource URL does not identify a plan invocation.
The Session has no readable plan for this invocation.
The Session history read failed.

A bundle's detail document or image exists but cannot be read: `too-large` beyond a size limit, `network` when the npm file CDNs cannot be reached, `invalid` for a malformed locale file or `meta.detail`, or a named file that does not exist. Bundle files come from local directories and public CDNs, which never answer `denied`.
The display language is not a BCP 47 language id.
The profile lists no such bundle, or its directory cannot be resolved.

A detail document exists but cannot be read: `too-large` beyond a size limit, `network` when a source cannot be reached, `denied` when Git refuses the repository with the user's credentials, `git-unavailable` when the repository must be cloned and Git cannot run, `invalid` for a malformed locale file or `meta.detail`, or a named file that does not exist.
The index could not be fetched: network failure, timeout, redirect, non-2xx status, or a body over the size limit.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly url: string; readonly reason: string }

oneOf.description: The fetched document is not valid format-1 JSON; `path` names the offending JSON value.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly url: string; readonly path: string; readonly reason: string }

oneOf.description: An index URL is not http(s), or carries credentials or a fragment.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly url: string; readonly reason: string }

oneOf.description: A search page request is out of range; `field` names the offending query field.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly field: string; readonly reason: string }

oneOf.description: Index sources cannot be saved without the settings service and this service's profile entry.
The URL is not one of the configured index sources.
The index lists no such plugin or version.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly name: string; readonly version: string }

oneOf.description: The non-owner principal lacks access, the resources are invalid, or its policy failed.
An interaction answer does not match the pending revision; the answer is not accepted.
The Agent cannot accept this operation in its current state or at this address.
A prompt attachment is invalid or unavailable for this Session.
The requested working directory conflicts with the existing Session.
The addressed Session cannot be forked in its current state.
The supplied time zone is not a supported IANA time zone.
The source Session must be opened and migrated before it can be forked.
The requested provider and model are unavailable; select an available model.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly provider: string; readonly model: string }

oneOf.description: The named Session does not exist; produced by every layer that resolves a SessionId.
A wait observation ended before a stopping state; the caller should reread.
The Session projection snapshot is unavailable.
Provider credentials are unavailable for the requested Session operation.
The selected provider exposes no usable model catalog.
The addressed inbox item is no longer pending.
A changed Session title revision rejects the requested rename.
The current turn no longer accepts the queued item as steering.
The requested Session title fails title validation.
No state arrived before the deadline; a timeout after a state returns its value instead.
The Session could not be attached to the requested Workspace.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly sessionId: SessionId; readonly workspaceId: string }

oneOf.description: Another writer holds the Session, preventing this operation from acquiring it.
The stored revision moved after the caller read it. Its own outcome rather than an invalid request: the caller must re-read and re-apply.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly ns: string; readonly expected: number; readonly actual: number }

oneOf.description: Every seam refusal that is not a stale write: an unregistered or malformed namespace, a read-only provider, schema validation, storage.
Audio encoding or intake limits prevented transcription.
The selected provider rejected transcription.
Image admission or model image-capability refusal.
The addressed subagent descriptor cannot be read from the durable catalog.
The child cannot admit the requested Prompt or addressed interruption with its current runtime state.
A browser-supplied zone is neither UTC nor a canonical IANA name.
No subagent is available at the supplied parent and child address.
The addressed child cannot take a continuation.
No live Agent carries the addressed parent session.
The claimed parent does not own the addressed child.
Input or resize was refused without invalidating the output attachment.
Retained screens and pending allocations consume the Session's terminal quota.
The terminal identity is missing or has begun process cleanup.
Client terminal failure preserved through the Remote stream supervisor.
The path is not a directory, so it has no children to list.
No entry exists at that path inside the workspace.
The path is not a regular file, so it has no text to read.
The content read so far is not decodable UTF-8 text, or the page carries NUL bytes.
The directory listing or watch path resolves outside the Session's workspace root.
The requested page exceeds the configured byte cap; nothing is returned.
oneOf.x-typescript-details: { readonly path: string; readonly limit: number }

oneOf.description: An `absolute` address has no Session to authorize its Host call. Raised by the Client provider; the Host never emits it. Session addresses are resolved by the Host without a Client Session summary.

The address is not a `dsh-resource://file/` address in a scope the provider recognizes: `session/<sessionId>/<path>` or `absolute/<absolute path>`. Raised by the Client provider; the Host never emits it.
The filesystem provider cannot initialize a watch for this target.
The requested directory cannot back a Workspace.
The Session or its anchor is not in the Workspace's manual order.
Another Workspace already uses the requested name.
No registration carries that Workspace identity.
The Session still has running work — its own turn, a subagent, a background job, or an active schedule — so archiving was refused without a write; `activity` names what must stop first.
